description: SQL-EQ-03, deciding variants: which spelling represents a group of values that compare equal, with insertion order and an index changed one at a time. Eq1 inserts 'ae', U+00E6, 'AE'; Eq2 inserts U+00E6, 'ae', 'AE'; Eq3 is Eq1 with an index on t. Asks SELECT DISTINCT t, GROUP BY t with Count, Min/Max/First/Last of t, ORDER BY t and UNION of the table with itself. Follow-up probe (status F) for SQL-EQ-03, SQL-EQ-01; runs on a read-only open of fixture r-q-expr-sql-main through DAO.DBEngine.120; each recordset reads Name, Type and Value of every field. Each statement is preceded by a marker (a DROP TABLE of a table that does not exist, which always fails), so DBEngine.Errors read after the statement shows that statement's own failure or the marker's, never an older one.

args.text: SELECT t, Count(*) AS n FROM Eq1 GROUP BY t
SELECT Min(t) AS mn, Max(t) AS mx, First(t) AS f, Last(t) AS l FROM Eq1
SELECT ID, t FROM Eq1 ORDER BY t
SELECT t FROM Eq1 UNION SELECT t FROM Eq1
SELECT t, Count(*) AS n FROM Eq2 GROUP BY t
SELECT Min(t) AS mn, Max(t) AS mx, First(t) AS f, Last(t) AS l FROM Eq2
SELECT ID, t FROM Eq2 ORDER BY t
SELECT t FROM Eq2 UNION SELECT t FROM Eq2
SELECT t, Count(*) AS n FROM Eq3 GROUP BY t
SELECT Min(t) AS mn, Max(t) AS mx, First(t) AS f, Last(t) AS l FROM Eq3
SELECT ID, t FROM Eq3 ORDER BY t
SELECT t FROM Eq3 UNION SELECT t FROM Eq3
